title: OR does not evaluate its second argument when the first is TRUE
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", OR ( [Order Count] > 0, ERROR ( "second argument" ) ) )

source.quote: The function evaluates the arguments until the first TRUE argument, then returns TRUE .
source.supports: evaluation stops at the first TRUE

derivation: [Order Count] is 7, so the first argument is TRUE. OR stops there and ERROR is never evaluated.
